text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x) ::: Pets are allowed in building x.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in building x.
EqualDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is equal to one month's rent.
MoreDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is more than one month's rent.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ::: Tom owns cat Fluffy.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: Building x is a managed building.
Rent(x, $2000) ::: The monthly rent at building x is $2000.
MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ::: Tom will move in with Fluffy.
MaxDeposit($1500) ::: The security deposit is no more than $1500.
Premises:
∃x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (DepositRequired(x) → ∃y (EqualDeposit(y) ∨ MoreDeposit(y))) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ∧ Cat(fluffy) ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat.
∀x (Cat(x) → Allowed(x)) ::: Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ∧ Rent(oliveGarden, $2000) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building with a monthly rent of $2000.
(MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ∧ MaxDeposit($1500)) ↔ Rent(oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
$2000 > $1500 ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
EqualDeposit(oliveGarden) ∨ MoreDeposit(oliveGarden) ::: The security deposit at the Olive Garden is either $2000 or more.
